dataset.split_protocol: 60/20/20 group-stratified IID benchmark; identical prediction inputs stay together. No reliable customer identifier exists, so this is not customer-entity isolation.

preserved_fields.duration: Original values retained; excluded from parsing, fitted statistics, clipping, imputation, planning, quality guardrails and training duplicate comparison.

dataset.training_deduplication_rule: If enabled: merge normalized identical modeling inputs with identical labels before outlier replacement and imputation. This is not customer-entity deduplication; independent source records can be merged. Report reference_rows_retained/reference_rows_removed.
dataset.pollution_scope: training only; validation and test are unmodified source holdouts

quality_before.quality_count_scope: prediction features only; duration is preserved metadata
quality_before.duplicate_rule: Equal prediction inputs and target; identifiers and duration are excluded. Cleaning deduplicates normalized values before outlier replacement and imputation.
